description: Exploit. On the E010 recipe, change only the Muon learning rate for the conv filters from 0.24 to 0.36 (×1.5). The SGD groups (BN, whitening bias, head), momentum 0.6, batch size 2000, schedule shape, epochs and Lookahead/EMA stay the same. The 0.24 value comes from CIFAR-10 airbench94_muon, and E006's surprise gain (+0.66 pp, outside every member's range) suggests the CIFAR-100 optimum has not been explored.
